attributes.title: CASSW Annual Conference 2027: The Architecture of Care
attributes.venue: Los Angeles County Office of Education (LACOE)
attributes.cme_provider: National Association of Social Workers (CEU provider)
attributes.organizer: California Association of School Social Workers
attributes.summary:
The California Association of School Social Workers holds its 2027 conference, "The Architecture of Care: Anchoring Our Schools in Uncertain Times", on February 11 and 12, 2027, at the Los Angeles County Office of Education in Downey. Sessions run from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. on both days.

NASW is listed as the CEU provider, with at least 10 CEUs across the two days. CEUs are free for CASSW members; non-members pay a separate CEU fee of $15 for one day or $25 for both days.

Registration is open. Non-members pay $350 for both days or $210 for one day. Direct and peripheral members pay $210 or $126, retired members $175 or $105, and student members $87.50 or $52.50. Group codes take 15% to 20% off larger orders.
